excerpts.author: gcolvin
excerpts.content:
Taking a few minutes to clear up some old confusion.  EIP-2315 *would in fact* reduce the number and gas cost of instructions needed to write and call subroutines.

This is how you write a subroutine with EIP-2315. 10 gas.
```
DIVIDE:
   beginsub
   div
   returnsub
```
This is how you call it. 19 gas.
```
   0x02
   0x03
   DIVIDE
   jumpsub
```
7 instructions, 39 gas total, including for the division itself.

This is how you can write a subroutine now. 17 gas.

```
DIVIDE:
   jumpdest
   div
   swap1
   jump
```
This is how you call it.  ~~32~~ 29 gas.
```
   RTN_DIV
   0x02
   0x03
   DIVIDE
   jump
RTN_DIV:
   jumpdest
   ~~swap1~~
```
~~11~~ 10 instructions, ~~50~~ 47 gas total.
